comment: CENTRAL allowlist for the anti-binary-growth integration-test-layout guard.
SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH read by BOTH:
- scripts/check-integration-test-layout.mjs (the fast-fail CI Node check), and
Each entry is an EXACT, stale-failing exception: { package, target, src_path, reason }.
- EXACT: package + target + normalized src_path must all match a real cargo-metadata test target.
- NO globs, NO prefixes, NO package-wide switches.
- STALE-FAILING: if an allowlisted (package,target) no longer exists in cargo metadata,
or its src_path moved, the guard FAILS — a removed binary cannot leave a dead exception.
Adding an entry requires a genuine 'needs a separate test process' justification (process-global
state that must be isolated in its own binary).

allow.reason: process-global VERTER_LSP_AUDIT_TRACE_OUT env mutation; separate binary isolates it and preserves exact test parity
